rcPromoted.note: Phase 11 must promote the approved release candidate before a production Android tag is created.

playConsoleAppCreated.note: The com.nvetcare application must exist in the intended Google Play Console account.

playAppSigningEnabled.note: Google Play App Signing must be enabled and the ownership/custody model documented.

uploadCertificatePinned.note: ANDROID_UPLOAD_CERT_SHA256 must be provisioned from the approved upload certificate and verified by the release workflow.

privacyPolicyPublished.note: A public production privacy-policy URL suitable for the Play listing must be verified.

dataSafetyReviewed.note: Google Play Data safety declarations must be reviewed against actual app permissions and data flows.

signedAabVerified.note: A successful Release Android run must produce a signed AAB, SHA-256 checksum and release metadata from an immutable tag.

internalTrackUploaded.note: The signed candidate must be uploaded to a non-production Play track before production rollout.

physicalDeviceSmokeVerified.note: At least two physical Android devices must complete login, pet, booking, appointment and recovery smoke tests.

android16BehaviorReviewCompleted.note: Android 16/API 36 behavior changes were reviewed against the current mobile architecture; explicit predictive-back and large-screen stabilization decisions are enforced by CI while external physical-device evidence remains separate.
